SELECT id, slug, title, tag, summary, external_url, status, pinned, view_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM article
ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(published_at, created_at) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, slug, title, tag, summary, content, external_url, status, pinned, view_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM article WHERE slug = #{slug} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS count FROM article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY count DESC, tag ASC
